reference: She will buy another charm when she comes to this market again.
sk: Kúpi si ďalší prívesok, keď príde na tento trh znova.
cz: Koupí si další přívěsek, až přijde na tenhle trh znovu.
acceptable: She {will|is going to} buy {another|one more} {charm|pendant} when she {comes to this market again|comes back to this market|returns to this market}.
When she {comes to this market again|comes back to this market|returns to this market}, she {will|is going to} buy {another|one more} {charm|pendant}.

mistakes.text: She will buy another {charm|pendant} when she will come to this market again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „when“ o budúcnosti patrí Present Simple, nie „will“: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „when“ o budoucnosti patří Present Simple, ne „will“: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “when” referring to the future, use Present Simple, not “will”: “when she comes”.

mistakes.text: She will buy another {charm|pendant} when she come to this market again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „she“ má Present Simple koncovku -s: „she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „she“ má Present Simple koncovku -s: „she comes“.

mistakes.text: She will buy another {charm|pendant} when she is coming to this market again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Časová veta o jednej budúcej udalosti je v Present Simple: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Časová věta o jedné budoucí události je v Present Simple: „when she comes“.
mistakes.feedback_en: A time clause about a single future event uses Present Simple: “when she comes”.

mistakes.text: She buys another {charm|pendant} when she comes to this market again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Buys“ znie ako zvyk; o jednom budúcom nákupe treba „will buy“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Buys“ zní jako zvyk; o jednom budoucím nákupu je potřeba „will buy“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Buys” sounds like a habit; for one future purchase use “will buy”.

mistakes.text: She will buy {other|an other} {charm|pendant} when she comes to this market again.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre „ďalší“ pri jednej veci patrí „another“ (jedno slovo), nie „other“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro „další“ u jedné věci patří „another“ (jedno slovo), ne „other“.
